topics: auroras, tornadoes, hydrothermal vents and salt flats

integration: Rewrote the uploaded material into original concise exam-oriented study notes in the existing Study Notes UI. The source PDFs and third-party watermarked map images are not copied into the public repository. Existing local study progress, bookmarks, notes and logs are untouched.
correctionsAndCautions: Cabinet Mission grouping corrected: Group A included Madras, Bombay, United Provinces, Bihar, Central Provinces and Orissa; Group B included Punjab, NWFP and Sind; Group C included Bengal and Assam. The uploaded note's Group B/Group C allocation and Baluchistan placement were incorrect.

Heat-wave notes expanded: basic IMD station thresholds are 40°C plains, 30°C hills and 37°C coastal, but declaration also depends on departure-from-normal, severity and duration criteria. Do not teach absolute thresholds alone.

India biosphere-reserve counts and UNESCO World Network membership are time-sensitive. An older MoEFCC annual report lists 18 nationally designated reserves and 11 UNESCO-network reserves at its publication date; use a dated current official list for present counts.
COP30 notes are retrospective: COP30 was held in Belém in November 2025; distinguish adopted Belém Political Package decisions from pre-conference proposals and drafts.
E20 is a dated policy fact: the official PIB 2026 factsheet reports India achieved 20% blending in 2025. Earlier target documents should be labelled by publication date.
International Big Cat Alliance is described as a conservation alliance; do not call it a global treaty-based alliance without evidence of a binding treaty.

PVTG lists, national-park lists, lake superlatives, current scheme guidelines, carbon-market rules and PFAS regulation require current official verification; old map notes are not authoritative current registers.
Vedic chronology and social transitions are broad scholarly conventions, not precise dates for every text or a uniform change across the subcontinent.
Constitutional-source comparisons are mnemonic associations; use the current Constitution's text for legal answers. Some rights apply to all persons while others are citizen-specific.
